rationale.audience: AI founders understand the infrastructure problem, business/technology viewers understand permission and money, and a new viewer can understand the question 'who authorized it?' without knowing NerveSystem.
rationale.stakes: The video connects autonomous software to money and physical machines, making the authority problem concrete.
rationale.hook: The viewer sees AI already acting before the explanation begins, then the authority question interrupts the action.
rationale.packaging: The question 'Who Authorized It?' supports simple visual packaging around a frozen real-world action.
rationale.funnel: This is discovery content. It explains the category/problem before asking anyone to buy NerveSystem.
